notes: Bit rate range stated as 100 Mbps to 1.25 Gbps. Standard (C-temp) operating range 0°C to +70°C; industrial (I-temp) -40°C to +85°C. Power consumption < 1.0 W per BiDi function. Power budget stated as 11 dB in title/ordering; technical table lists 0–10.5 dB with max dispersion penalty 1 dB. Tx/Rx nominal 1550 nm / 1310 nm; transmit wavelength range 1540–1560 nm; receiver wavelength range 1260–1360 nm. Transmitter output power, receiver minimum input power, and overload are average power (footnote 1). Receiver minimum input power and overload at 1.25 Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², PRBS 2⁷-1, back-to-back (footnote 2). SM (2x LC). DDM per SFF-8472.
suggestions: Consider a dedicated power_budget_db field; separate temp_min_c/temp_max_c per C-temp vs I-temp SKU; bit_rate_mbps alongside bit_rate_gbps to avoid unit conversion; CSFP as explicit form_factor enum value.
